prompt: # Plan { "intent": "Deduplicate orders table into Silver layer keeping the latest record per order_id using updated_at", "layer": "silver", "strategy": "dedup_l
text:
```json
{
  "parameters": [
    "orders_table",
    "target_table",
    "watermark",
    "key_columns"
  ],
  "cells": [
    {
      "title": "Read incremental bronze orders data",
      "code": "from pyspark.sql import functions as F

watermark_val = int(watermark)

orders_df = (
    spark.read.table(orders_table)
    .select(
        F.col("order_id").cast("string"),
        F.col("customer_id").cast("string"),
        F.col("order_status").cast("string"),
        F.col("purchased_at").cast("bigint"),
        F.col("delivered_at").cast("bigint"),
        F.col("updated_at").cast("bigint")
    )
    .filter(F.col("updated_at") > watermark_val)
)",
      "cites": [
        "table:orders",
        "pattern:module.ingest-bronze",
        "standard:notebook.explicit-schemas-and-column-lists"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Validate quality rules and deduplicate orders keeping latest record",
      "code": "from pyspark.sql.window import Window

# Ensure non-null natural key as quality rule prior to deduplication/write
valid_orders_df = orders_df.filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())

window_spec = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("updated_at").desc())

deduped_orders_df = (
    valid_orders_df.withColumn("_row_num", F.row_number().over(window_spec))
    .filter(F.col("_row_num") == 1)
    .drop("_row_num")
)",
      "cites": [
        "pattern:adr.0005",
        "standard:notebook.silver-keeps-one-current-row-per-key",
        "standard:notebook.quality-rules-run-before-writes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Merge deduplicated orders into silver target table",
      "code": "from delta.tables import DeltaTable

target_delta = DeltaTable.forName(spark, target_table)
keys = [k.strip() for k in key_columns.split(",")]
join_condition = " AND ".join([f"target.{col} = source.{col}" for col in keys])

(
    target_delta.alias("target")
    .merge(
        deduped_orders_df.alias("source"),
        join_condition
    )
    .whenMatchedUpdateAll()
    .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()
    .execute()
)",
      "cites": [
        "pattern:adr.0005",
        "standard:notebook.writes-are-idempotent",
        "standard:notebook.silver-keeps-one-current-row-per-key"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
